name: Joybound People & Pets - Free Pet Food
description: Free pet food for Contra Costa County residents at FoodShare pantry events
fullDescription: Joybound's FoodShare pantry helps Contra Costa County families keep their pets by providing free pet food at pantry events.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free dry dog and cat food
- Wet/canned food when available (not guaranteed)
- No special or prescription diets
- First-come, first-served while supplies last
- Helps prevent pet surrender due to cost
howToGetIt:
1. Must be a Contra Costa County resident, 18 or older
2. Check Joybound's website or events calendar for upcoming FoodShare pantry dates
3. Arrive early at 2890 Mitchell Drive, Walnut Creek (distribution starts at 2 pm and fills up quickly)
4. Questions? Email cs@joybound.org or call the Resource Center at ext. 450
keywords: Joybound, FoodShare, free pet food, dog food, cat food, Contra Costa, pet pantry, Walnut Creek, keep pet
